crossRefs.note: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.
Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,
He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,
You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.
He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.
When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did…
Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing…
He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath…
He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat…
Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

people.name: Capernaum
people.line: Town in Galilee; center of Jesus' ministry

translations.web: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
translations.bsb: Then Jesus and His companions went to Capernaum, and right away Jesus entered the synagogue on the Sabbath and began to teach.
translations.kjv: And they went into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught.
translations.asv: And they go into Capernaum; and straightway on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.
